items.q: How is CRO different from SEO or PPC?
items.a: SEO and PPC bring people to your site. CRO turns more of those people into booked appointments. Without CRO, every dollar you spend on traffic is capped by the conversion rate you already have — usually 1–3% for dermatology sites. Doubling your conversion rate effectively doubles the ROI of every marketing dollar you're already spending.

items.q: How quickly will I see results?
items.a: Baseline audit and first shipped variants land in the first 30 days. Statistically-significant test results typically appear between weeks 4 and 12 depending on your traffic volume. Practices with 5,000+ monthly visitors usually see the first confirmed win within 6 weeks; lower-traffic clinics take longer because sample sizes matter more than speed.

items.q: Do you need access to my site to run tests?
items.a: Yes — we install an experimentation platform (VWO, Convert, or Optimizely, your choice) and analytics, plus a heatmap tool. Everything is HIPAA-aware: no PHI is captured, session replays mask form fields by default, and we sign a BAA where required.

Roughly 60% of well-designed tests either lose or come back inconclusive — that's normal and healthy. A losing test is a learning: it tells you the assumption behind the change was wrong, which is often more valuable than a small win. Winners compound; learnings prevent expensive redesigns down the road.

items.q: Can you work with our existing site, or do we need a rebuild?
items.a: We work with any modern stack — WordPress, Webflow, custom React, headless. If your site has structural problems (poor Core Web Vitals, no mobile-first templates, no analytics wiring), we'll flag them in the audit and recommend targeted rebuilds only where the ROI justifies it. CRO doesn't require a full redesign.

items.q: Is this compliant with HIPAA and medical advertising rules?
items.a: Every experiment is reviewed against HIPAA, state medical-board advertising standards, and platform policies (Meta, Google Ads health verticals). We don't test claims about outcomes we can't substantiate, and we never capture PHI in analytics or session replay.

Diagnostic is a one-time engagement. Growth Sprint and Compounding CRO are month-to-month with a 30-day notice. You keep all test data, insights, playbooks, and analytics configuration when you offboard.
